picks.title: Final Equity-Pact Deal Offer Includes AI Provisions, Streamer Residuals
picks.rationale: A new contract offer: UK actors' union Equity sends Pact's final 2027-2029 TV and film offer to members with a 'yes' recommendation. Its four-part AI section covers digital replicas, digital alteration of performances, 'Synthetics' and AI training licensing, the rules UK productions would work under.
picks.excerpt: UK actors union Equity is taking Pact's final offer for UK TV and film (2027-2029) to its 8,000 members with a 'yes' recommendation; its four-pronged AI section covers digital replicas, digital alteration of performances, 'Synthetics' and AI training licensing.

picks.title: French Movie Regulator Won't Fund AI Dubbing and Subtitling
picks.rationale: A regulator funding rule: since Nov. 1, CNC-funded dubbing, subtitling and audio-description work must involve at least one human author. This directly changes how French productions can use AI localisation.
picks.excerpt: France's CNC will no longer fund dubbing, subtitling or audio-description projects made without human creators; from Nov. 1 funded films, series, games and animation must involve at least one (graphic) author, though AI tools are not banned outright.

picks.title: HPA NET Roundtable: AI as a Second Unit
picks.rationale: Practical guidance from post supervisors: treat AI as a 'second unit' with a defined brief. Retakes are the real cost of an AI shot, and AI is landing first in background removal, uprez and set extensions.
picks.excerpt: HPA's October NET Roundtables framed AI as a 'second unit' that works on a defined brief while humans stay in charge; post supervisors agreed retakes are the real cost of an AI shot, that AI is landing first in background removal, uprez and set extensions, and that local AI plus content credentials matter.

picks.title: Virtual Content Creator Roundtable
picks.rationale: Blackmagic describes a new DaVinci Resolve feature that lets AI assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT Codex build highlight edits, remove clips and render deliverables. Editors can try agent-driven editing in Resolve now.
picks.excerpt: Vendors and creators on how social creators adopt film/episodic workflows; Blackmagic points to a new DaVinci Resolve feature that lets AI assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT Codex build highlight edits, remove clips and render deliverables, while others cite agentic AI for footage organization and rough cuts.

picks.title: 경민대, 극장용 AI 애니메이션 제작 산학 협력
picks.rationale: A new Korean theatrical AI project: students will work on 'Jonah', an AI biblical musical animation targeting a late-2027 release. Studio Cinetics is the AI tech partner.
picks.excerpt: 경민대가 강단스튜디오·스튜디오시네틱스와 협약을 맺고 극장용 AI 성경 뮤지컬 애니메이션 '요나'(2027년 하반기 개봉 목표) 제작에 재학생을 참여시킨다. 스튜디오시네틱스가 AI 기술 파트너를 맡는다.

dedup.note: The pool had 13 items. Dropped as duplicates or follow-ups: Economist.co.kr MooAm Tokyo pipeline repeats the MooAm hybrid pipeline story (etnews, 11-04). Deadline SAG-AFTRA takedowns adds more Web Summit remarks to the THR card from 11-13, so it is commentary only. Korea Times 'Raphael' review covers the film already featured in the Korea Times card from 11-06; a review is not a new event. No Film School Premiere AI Assistant and Variety Project Live Set are more Adobe MAX coverage after the 11-11 Premiere card (saturated). THR CAA AI celebrity ads was dropped after the coordinator flagged a cross-section clash: it is the same story as marketing's Digiday Ogilvy x CAA card from 2026-11-10. postPerspective Virtual Content Creator Roundtable replaces it; its new item is the DaVinci Resolve AI-assistant (Claude/Codex) editing feature, which is distinct from the 10-28 Resolve 21.1.2 IntelliSearch card. That makes 2 postPerspective cards, which is within the cap of 2; there are 4 distinct outlets. Not picked: SportsWorld overview piece (its Japan drama angle already ran with Fuji TV on 11-07) and the Korea Daily Lee Myung-se interview (an interview, and close to the 11-10 Variety Korean pioneers card). Cross-section: Equity-Pact is assigned to movies, so books drops Voice Over Herald. The orchestrator should exact-grep all 5 URLs in published_urls.json before roll. The Yonhap item had no og_image, so og_image uses the Segye image of the same story that the librarian recorded.
